Each local category (default & custom) will be written to a GitHub List of the same name:

· Existing same-name lists will be overwritten (repos no longer matching are removed)
· Missing lists will be created (private by default)
· Repos are added to the lists matching their category
· Memberships in lists not managed locally are preserved
